# Coverage floors — generated by scripts/coverage-gate.sh --update.
# --update can only RAISE these. Lowering needs --allow-lower and removing
# needs --allow-remove, so either one shows up as an argued change.
#
# These are the CI (linux/amd64) numbers. Package totals are whole percent and
# function floors are one decimal — see the rationale at the top of
# scripts/coverage-gate.sh. Regenerate on Linux, or copy from the measured table
# the gate prints when it fails.
pkg github.com/cervantesh/calvoproxy/cmd 59
pkg github.com/cervantesh/calvoproxy/internal/router 81
# 84 -> 73 -> 96 across v0.14.0. The dip was rc.6 emitting code for policy
# features policy-rules.yaml does not use (no deny rules, no `requires:`
# clauses), which grew the denominator by statements no runtime config can
# reach. "Unreachable in production" turned out not to mean "untestable":
# generated_conditions_test.go assembles generatedEngine directly and exercises
# the deny loop and the condition guards. Worth doing rather than living with a
# lowered floor, because what that code implements is fail-closed — a condition
# that cannot be answered must DENY — and it starts governing real traffic the
# day the policy grows its first `requires:` clause.
pkg github.com/cervantesh/calvoproxy/internal/router/policyrules 96
pkg github.com/cervantesh/calvoproxy/internal/telemetry 100
